hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a buy-and-burn mechanism: on buys (ETH→token) it collects a 1.7% ETH fee into a burn pot; on sells (token→ETH) it collects a 1.7% token fee queued for burning. Every 20 swaps a buyback is signaled. Exact output swaps are blocked. Liquidity additions are limited to once per token, and sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Additionally, afterSwap contains an allowlist check on tx.origin (controlled by the deployer) that can be activated by anyone calling superposition() to block sells for non-allowlisted addresses.
